verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a specific iOS mobile SDK for Tap to Pay on iPhone (adyen-pos-docs-7, mobile-ios/build/tap-to-pay.md) and general Terminal API/POS integration, but there is no evidence of an equivalent Android SDK or a general-purpose in-app POS SDK beyond the narrow Tap to Pay use case, and one community account describes lengthy, difficult card-present integration work with Adyen (adyen-pos-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit Android mobile SDK documentation, broader in-app card-present SDK beyond Tap to Pay, and independent developer confirmation of smooth mobile SDK integration.
